agents.role: Coordinate the work: delegate concrete tasks to the other agents with ask and report the outcome honestly.
Analyze the repository and recommend a bounded implementation.
Implement the agreed change in the shared workspace, run builds and tests and fix failures.
Independently run the repository's build, test and lint commands and report each command, its exit code and outcome (or NOT RUN); do not edit source.
Review the actual changes independently and identify risks or blockers.
